claims.text: GC or chlamydia (confirmed or sus): refer all partners from the 60 days b4 Sx onset for eval, testing and presumptive tx.
claims.quote: Men who have acute sexually transmitted epididymitis confirmed or suspected to be caused by N. gonorrhoeae or C. trachomatis should be instructed to refer all sex partners during the previous 60 days before symptom onset for evaluation, testing, and presumptive treatment
